opening.argument: Read the demonstrations together with the video’s stated purpose. The description calls it “simply a recorded experience of testing a crypto project from an IT and analytical point of view” and expressly says, “This is not a guide, a promotion, or a promise of results.” The trading rule, reported returns, and withdrawal sequence are therefore presented as personal testing and demonstration, not established encouragement to invest. The free-USDT wording and withdrawal submission may create ambiguity, but the available evidence does not establish that the withdrawal completed or that the reported results were independently verified.
